at_sea:
aider-shim is [PROVED] (cairn 0aca14d, commons 296afd6, both pushed clean). The device holds aider IN-PROCESS in its own venv, answers sys.modules['litellm'] with our own surface before aider is imported, fences every ask to an exact (model, provider), and assembles the prompt only from berthed chart-packet spans. 80 teeth across four proofs, all re-run twice and re-sealed under netns at 19:21 through sink='validations'. Live fire done: qwen3-coder:30b on hex produced a correct diff through our surface, inference_domain meter +3 calls / +3213 tokens. Inspector 20/20 OPEN, zero findings. Two verdict artifacts stand; the second supersedes by latest-wins and the FIRST IS DELIBERATELY UNTOUCHED, because writing it is what surfaced the third defect. The WATCHME probe is armed and waiting on five shimmed tickets with both columns filled; its cost column is still a declared hole and the horizon is what keeps that waiting loud.

THE CLOSE COST THREE DEFECTS AND EVERY ONE WAS FOUND BY DOING, NOT CHECKING. (1) aider's repo map splices a digest of the whole repo into the prompt AFTER translate.py finishes counting spans, so falsifier clause (7) could be violated while its own instrument reported zero — map_tokens=0 is the design; surfaced by the first live fire dying on `import networkx`. (2) The charter promised a per-piece probe column the probe did not carry; now a declared hole. (3) THE ONE THAT NEARLY SHIPPED: the probe read artifact['criteria'] / 'passed' while the verdict door writes artifact['verdicts'] / ('pass','fail'), so the MEASURED half of the watch was structurally dead and would have reported green=0 forever under a healthy-looking carrier — the same shape as the survey-floor trouble in the inbox. Seventeen sealed teeth missed it because the FIXTURE hand-wrote the reader's invented shape. Fixed by composing the door (verdict_error asked, OUTCOMES imported, one tooth building its artifact THROUGH write_verdict in an injected tempdir world); mutation-validated 3/3, and the original defect now reds four teeth where it red none.
next_direction:
MY READ, NOT RATIFIED — Akien has not chosen the next move. Three candidates, cheapest-first:

(a) FILE THE TICKET EDGE (f) IS OWED. Nothing in the corpus reds a proof whose fixture was never checked against the producer it stands for. That is a general hollow-proof class the tester cannot see, and it is not aider_shim's to own. The survey-floor trouble standing in the inbox today is the identical shape at a different seam — one predicate might cover both.

(b) BUILD A REAL TICKET THROUGH THE SHIM. This is the only thing that answers hypothesis 8, which its own author marked CARRIED and which constrain put explicitly OUT of this voyage. It is also the only thing that makes the offload probe start accumulating rows. n=1 of evidence exists (the live fire's correct diff on a synthetic piece); n=5 with both columns is what enough demands.

(c) THE COST COLUMN'S INSTRUMENT. The probe's cc_calls hole is owed by ticket the-builds-tool-calls-are-evidence-about-the-chart. NOTE, and it may collapse that ticket: this voyage MEASURED its own tool calls by counting tool_use entries in the session transcript jsonl — 323 between the validate packet and PROVED. If the transcript is readable at close, the 'nothing counts the calls' hole may be smaller than /sail's charter believes.

The standing ladder (next-direction-session-continuity) is unchanged underneath all three: everything-below-is-working-fine, measured per rung, toward the librarian.

They are absent from disk and answered by our surfaces, and the netns seals hold — but whether holding a foreign program with telemetry clients in-process is acceptable as a STANDING arrangement has no law behind it. Not a red; an escalation nobody has answered.
